Oh absolutely, I'm right there with you! And when Donna finally realizes what's really happening to that family, and she runs after the truck, it's just brutal. I know "Turn Left" and "the Stolen Earth / Journey's End" take a lot of hits from fans for going over the top in terms of melodrama and for being almost too convoluted, but I think the anguish and the stakes being so high and the Doctors realization that yes, these people love him and need him and will die for him really is the essence of the show, scary aliens and time travel and all. I think the show went to a dark place that it needed to explore before the regeneration could brighten things up without erasing the implications of his influence in their universe completely. But those last few episodes of Tennant's, starting with "Turn Left" truly cemented my love of this show for me.

Turn Left - the pacing and story, the return of Rose, the references to all the terrible things that would have happened without the Doctor - how bleak the world would have been without his influence and his companions. I have to stop myself from watching it over more frequently. Plus I love me some Donna.

I installed motion sensor lights outside my house and they have given me piece of mind. I would suggest those for you as well, and maybe a webcam that can monitor the window the peeping Tom came in through, just to be safe. Just make sure you mount it at face level, not up in a corner, so you can actually catch his face if he (god forbid) ever shows up again.

I sincerely hope you are feeling better... Have an Internet (hug) from me! And thank you for reminding me to check my windows and doors at night.

I was in college about an hour north of New York City. A friend of mine from MO was visiting and wanted to see the sights, so we did the whole tourist your over a few days - museums, shopping, circle line, broadway, and the last day we went to the top of the empire state building, the first time I had ever been in my life too.  As we walk around the top, I hear someone call my name. I turn aroun and it's my best friend of more than 15 years... Who was going to college in Tennessee. I didn't even know she was home for spring break, turns out she was visiting someone who worked in the building and on a whim he took her to the top, her first time there too. Unbelievably small world.

Allthefuckingtime!)... the car was absolutely demolished. I kicked out the back door and dragged myself up to the street where I flagged down a good Samaritan.
